# pistol random opening book, v1 — the arena's PRIMARY SPRT book.
#
# Pinned by SHA-256 in crates/pistol-cli/tests/random_openings_document_tests.rs
# (RANDOM_OPENINGS_V1_SHA256), and regenerated byte for byte from the config named
# below by `random_openings_v1_is_what_this_build_produces` in the same file. This
# book has no external input, so "the committed bytes are the bytes this build
# writes" is a test rather than an errand (docs/decisions.md D-152, D-177).
#
# One position per line, in the canonical move-list encoding (docs/decisions.md
# D-6) — the exact tail the `position` verb takes. There is NO commentary column:
# these positions have no provenance beyond the parameters below, and a column that
# said nothing would invite a reader to look for meaning in it.
#
# WHY A RANDOM BOOK IS THE PRIMARY ONE. The research report's Deliverable 4
# prescribes synthetic openings; pairing neutralises whatever per-opening bias any
# one of these carries, since both engines play both seats of every one; and the
# supply of distinct games is unbounded, where a corpus book is capped by the
# corpus. WP-1.2a's openings_v1.txt is retained as the realism cross-check suite
# and is not retired (docs/decisions.md D-175).
#
# NO BALANCE FILTER, and the reason is arithmetic rather than a judgement. A turn
# places two stones, so a mate in one TURN needs four own stones already in a
# six-window and a mate in one PLY needs five; at five stones the largest holding
# is three. No position in this file holds a mate in one for either side, so there
# is nothing for a filter to remove — and no engine was consulted to decide that,
# which is what keeps this a fixture rather than a book under CLAUDE.md rule 8
# (docs/decisions.md D-151, D-175). The question reopens if k grows.
#
# How a position was made:
# param k_stones 5
# param n_openings 500
# param max_radius 5
# param seed 20260818
# param rng splitmix64
# param draw uniform_over_the_unused_cells_of_the_ball
# param dedupe canonical_form_over_the_12_lattice_symmetries
# param on_collision discard_the_candidate_and_draw_the_next
# param emission_order generation_order
# derived turn_structure p1@origin,p2,p2,p1,p1
# derived ball_cells 91
# derived candidates_drawn 500
# derived symmetry_collisions 0
# derived openings 500
#
# max_radius is a GENERATION knob and is NOT the legal radius. Game rule 5's
# LEGAL_RADIUS is a pinned constant in pistol-core and is never a knob; this
# number only says how far from the ORIGIN a sampled stone may land. Every
# placement is asked of pistol-core as it is made, at its own point in the
# sequence, and a stone the rules refuse ends the run (docs/decisions.md D-177).
#
# The seed is the only reason these positions and not others, so it is stated
# here as an input. There is no path, no timestamp and no hostname anywhere in
# this file: the same config gives the same bytes on any machine
# (CLAUDE.md rule 4).
#
# Emission order is GENERATION order, and that is deliberate. The draws are
# independent, so a prefix of this file is already a sample; sorting it by
# anything — coordinates, digest — would make a prefix a slice of whatever was
# sorted on instead (docs/decisions.md D-143's argument, in a book that gets it
# for free).
# body_sha256 f0bf76c5f53ae192d970a32f8127f3aae1910e5a8d4fb4374238e4450c6a152e
